fusions.name: Slammed Barricade
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Covering Fire
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone that deals 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw Fire
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds, with 1.5 times the usual threat.

fusions.name: Bulwark Closes
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
